reference: She wishes the river were the way it was last spring.
sk: Praje si, aby rieka bola taká ako minulú jar.
cz: Přeje si, aby řeka byla taková jako loni na jaře.
acceptable: {She|He} wishes {that |}the river were {the way|like|the same as} it was last spring.

mistakes.text: She wishes {that |}the river is {the way|like} it was last spring.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „wish“ o prítomnosti patrí Past Simple: „were“, nie „is“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „wish“ o přítomnosti patří Past Simple: „were“, ne „is“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “wish” about the present use a past form: “were”, not “is”.

mistakes.text: She wishes {that |}the river was {the way|like} it was last spring.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V hovorovej reči sa „was“ používa, no po „wish“ je štandardné „were“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V hovorové řeči se „was“ používá, ale po „wish“ je standardní „were“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Was” is common in speech, but after “wish” the standard form is “were”.

mistakes.text: She wishes {that |}the river would be {the way|like} it was last spring.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Wish + would“ je pre zmenu správania. Pri stave je prirodzenejšie „were“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Wish + would“ je pro změnu chování. U stavu je přirozenější „were“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Wish + would” is for changes in behaviour; for a state, “were” is more natural.

mistakes.text: She wish {that |}the river were {the way|like} it was last spring.
mistakes.feedback_en: With “she” the Present Simple form is “wishes”.

mistakes.text: She wishes {that |}the river were such as last spring.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Taká ako“ nie je „such as“. Povedz „the way it was last spring“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Taková jako“ není „such as“. Řekni „the way it was last spring“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Such as” means “for example”. Say “the way it was last spring”.

mistakes.text: She wishes {that |}the river were {the way|like} it is last spring.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Minulá jar je minulosť: „it was last spring“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Loňské jaro je minulost: „it was last spring“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Last spring is in the past: “it was last spring”.
